chars.G: GIRLFRIEND: a young woman of 28 with long dark wavy hair, no headscarf, wearing a mustard-yellow blazer over a white blouse, gold hoop earrings.
chars.N: NARRATOR: a man of 32 wearing a navy quarter-zip sweater over a light blue shirt, short black hair, neat short beard.
chars.W: COWORKER: a woman of 30 wearing a burgundy cardigan and a beige headscarf, black-rimmed glasses.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern open-plan office in Casablanca, seen from the doorway where her boyfriend stands: GIRLFRIEND hurriedly packs her desk things into a cardboard box, glancing sideways nervously, mid-act. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, curious suspicious mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At a small cafe table in Casablanca: GIRLFRIEND talks with a worried sad face, hand on her chest, while NARRATOR listens concerned across the table. Both faces visible, medium shot.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: GIRLFRIEND on the phone in a city street, looking away with a worried expression, saying she must go take care of her sick mother. Medium shot, face visible, background calm street with parked cars.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a parked car at night, GIRLFRIEND cries with tears on her cheeks, wiping her eyes, while NARRATOR beside her looks touched and moved. Both faces visible, medium close shot, warm streetlight.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On a bench in a Casablanca park: NARRATOR holds GIRLFRIEND's hands and reassures her with a kind smile; she looks down with an unreadable face. Both faces visible, medium shot.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR alone at his desk in a modern office in the evening, staring at his phone with no reply, frowning, puzzled and worried. Medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a modern office kitchen: COWORKER leans in and whispers something secret to NARRATOR, glancing around cautiously; NARRATOR listens with raised eyebrows. Both faces visible, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same office kitchen: COWORKER shakes her head with a surprised face, NARRATOR freezes in shock holding a coffee cup. Both faces visible, medium shot, dramatic but slightly comic mood.
